subject: Discovery follow-up & proposed kickoff agenda — HelioMetrics pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia@heliometrics.com>, Tom Rinaldi <tom.r@heliometrics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up & proposed kickoff agenda — HelioMetrics pilot

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed lightweight kickoff plan so we can get the pilot scoped and scheduled. High-level notes below; I’ve attached a short scope doc and a sample prompt set to make the evals concrete.

Key pain points you described
- Production inference latency spikes during peak batch windows impacting user experience (p95 variability 300–700ms)
- Token/unit costs that scale poorly for long contextual sessions (cost per session varies widely)
- Limited observability into per-route latency and token accounting across services

Stated goals for a successful pilot
- Reduce median token cost by ~30–40% for the assistant flows we tested
- Achieve p95 latency consistently under 250ms for single-turn 2–4k token requests in the hosted environment
- Validate rollout controls (canary & automatic fallback) and end-to-end tracing for a sample production route

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks) — summary
1) Environment: Redwood hosted Dedicated sandbox with a single reserved capacity pool (we’ll mirror your expected peak traffic profile).
2) Workload: Run 25k inference requests across the provided prompt set (attached) including long-context sessions.
3) Metrics & evals: cost per 1k tokens, p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput (requests/sec), quality sweep using your rubric.
4) Owners: HelioMetrics product (Alicia) + Redwood onboarding (Monica) + runtime lead (Sean).
5) Access & infra: We’ll need a read-only S3 bucket or sample data export, HubSpot contact for billing pilot, and an AWS IAM role for cross-account provisioning — details below.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Can you confirm the proposed success metrics and the 4-week timeline?
- Please share the S3 path or a small sample dataset (~20–50 examples) and an AWS account ID for provisioning.
- Please confirm whether your legal team will need a copy of our standard pilot agreement (DocuSign link below) or if you prefer to share a PO.

Attachments: pilot-scope-v0.3.pdf (PDF), sample_prompt_set.csv (CSV)

If that looks good I’ll propose exact kickoff slots next week (we typically start a pilot on a Tuesday to align ops).

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Chen <alicia@heliometrics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rinaldi <tom.r@heliometrics.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & proposed kickoff agenda — HelioMetrics pilot

Jordan —

Thanks for the succinct recap and the scope doc. High level: we’re very aligned on the goals. A few clarifications from our side below and one ask from security/legal.

Clarifications
- The 4-week window works for us but we’d prefer a short ramp week + 3-week active run (so effectively 4 calendar weeks).
- For the latency target, we want p95 under 250ms on our most common 3k-token routes — agreed.

Security/legal
- Our security team asked if you can fill the attached questionnaire (I started it and attached the partial answers) and also confirm whether logs that Redwood streams to our S3 will contain any raw PII. We can redact on our side but want to understand what you collect by default.

Access
- S3 bucket: s3://heliometrics-pilot-sample (we will upload a 50-example sample this afternoon).
- AWS account ID for provisioning: 123456789012

I’m looping in our CTO Tom for timeline ok — Tom, we’d like to aim to start provisioning next Tuesday 7/20. Does that work?

Best,
Alicia
Product Lead, HelioMetrics
---
Attachments: security_questionnaire_filled.pdf

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 17:30:00 -07:00

Thanks — quick internal note so we can action Alicia’s asks.

Internal allocation & ops notes
- I’ll serve as primary CSM for this pilot (onboarding, access coordination, weekly check-ins).
- Sean: can you own runtime provisioning and the performance eval (kernel/quantization recommendations)? We’ll need a short runbook for how we toggle canary policies.
- I’ll request a Dedicated sandbox with 2x standard GPU nodes and continuous batching enabled for the initial run; if Helio wants more aggressive latency we can spin up a smaller-quantized variant.

Security answer draft for Alicia
- By default Redwood streams structured metadata (request id, route, token counts, latency metrics, model id) to customer-configured sinks. Raw request bodies (prompts/responses) are not logged unless the customer opts-in; we can redact or hash fields prior to shipping. I’ll have security produce an official note but that should address their immediate concern.

Action items
1) Monica to send official security note and sample logging config by EOD tomorrow.
2) Sean to prepare provisioning checklist and confirm node specs by 7/14.
3) Jordan to send DocuSign pilot agreement and propose kickoff slots for week of 7/19.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference

Confirmed plan
- Kickoff provisioning start: Tue 20 Jul 2027
- Pilot run window: 26 Jul — 15 Aug (ramp week 7/20 — 7/25, active run 7/26 — 8/15)
- Success criteria: 30–40% token cost reduction on measured routes; p95 < 250ms for target 3k-token route; end-to-end tracing enabled for at least one production route.

What we’ll do before kickoff (by 7/19)
- Send DocuSign pilot agreement (link below) and receive a signed copy or PO.
- Redwood to provision Dedicated sandbox in your account using IAM role 123456789012:RedwoodPilotRole — please confirm the role name when it’s created.
- Monica to share the logging config & security note.
- Sean to post the provisioning checklist to the drive folder linked below.
